scope: Seven Oct-07 capture sessions; all manual/shadow; recorded neural result count is zero. Read-only analysis; no production control or TF changes deployed.
sdk_error_9: CameraError::FrameDropped in the shipped SDK header. Current onCubeEyeCameraError sets stopping=1 for every error; six sessions terminate shortly after this event.
priority: Handle SDK FrameDropped as a recoverable event, with event/sequence accounting; do not close the camera for a single frame drop.
Calibrate the ToF optical roll relative to gravity, then lens position/height. -90deg is strongly supported; a global height offset is not validated.
Repair frame timestamp/join scheduling and preprocessor throughput before changing neural drive. Bag receive ages include recording latency.
Freeze connectome weights initially. Calibrate sensory encoding and descending-neuron readout from synchronized human demonstrations, then compare held-out sessions.
Evaluate flat-ground progress, real >=58.8mm obstacle avoidance, measured negative obstacles, and unnecessary stationary/turn fraction separately.
limits: No neural response was recorded in these manual runs; the neural probe is a newly generated open-loop test, not historical driving evidence.
Geometry ablation samples every eighth raw frame with a recorded gravity match within 60ms. It changes only transform hypotheses and keeps the current scene/avoidance logic.
Raw journals and MCAP counts agree in the existing reports, but one session contains MCU parser corruption. Sensor acquisition loss is distinct from bag storage loss.
Motor speeds are encoder-derived; ground speed, slip, collision, actual obstacle height and hole depth are not independently labelled.
Do not use all manual commands as training pairs: most driving in the long 16:03 session occurs after ToF stops.
Full raw sensor recording adds Pi load; its timing cannot be assumed identical to the earlier unrecorded autonomous run.
